mcqs.q: The Sundarbans delta, shared between West Bengal and Bangladesh, is the world's largest mangrove forest and home to which apex predator?
mcqs.exp: The Sundarbans Mangroves are formed by the confluence of Ganga, Brahmaputra, and Meghna and house the Royal Bengal Tiger.

mcqs.q: Santiniketan, the university town founded by Maharshi Debendranath Tagore and expanded by Rabindranath Tagore, was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in which year?
mcqs.exp: Santiniketan was designated India's 41st UNESCO World Heritage Site in September 2023.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of West Bengal.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Kolkata. West Bengal covers a geographic area of 88,752 sq km across 23 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Hooghly (Bhagirathi-Hooghly), Teesta, Damodar, Rupnarayan, Subarnarekha.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Cultural and intellectual heartland of modern India. Birthplace of Rabindranath Tagore, Swami Vivekananda, and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose. Home to the Sundarbans (world's largest delta) and Darjeeling Himalayan Railway.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of West Bengal.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: West Bengal was formally instituted on 26 January 1950. Official language(s): Bengali (Classical Language), English.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Chhau (Purulia), Baul singing, Brita dance, Gambhira.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Durga Puja (UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage), Poila Boishakh, Ganga Sagar Mela.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of West Bengal.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is C. V. Ananda Bose.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of West Bengal is Mamata Banerjee.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Calcutta High Court (Oldest High Court in India, est. 1862).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Fishing cat | State Bird: White-throated kingfisher | State Flower: Night-flowering jasmine (Shephali) | State Tree: Chatim tree.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in West Bengal.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Coal (Raniganj - India's oldest coalfield, 1774), China clay, Dolomite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: West Bengal plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in West Bengal.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge (Rabindra Setu), Dakshineswar Kali Temple, Santiniketan (UNESCO 2023).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Sundarbans National Park (UNESCO), Gorumara, Jaldapara, Singalila, Buxa.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of West Bengal.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Kanyashree Prakalpa (UN Public Service First Prize), Lakshmir Bhandar, Swasthya Sathi.
